summary:
Visible screen inventory: At the top is an upload status banner/card showing the filename "step1-jpeg.jpg" on the left and "업로드 완료" (upload complete) on the right. Inside the same banner it says "원본 7.3MB · 이 첨부의 최대 크기 2MB", "업로드한 파일 1.5MB", and a warning message "압축된 첨부파일은 원본보다 화질이 낮아질 수 있습니다. 중요한 세부 내용이 유지되는지 확인하세요." Below that is a collapsible/help row with a triangle icon and the text "이유와 처리 제한 자세히".

The main form area begins with the required label "원본 이미지 *" and a counter "1/10 개". There is a segmented control with two options: "업로드" (selected) and "URL". Under it is a dashed drag-and-drop upload zone with an upload arrow icon and the text "이미지를 드래그 앤 드롭하거나 클릭하여 선택하세요" plus "지원 형식: JPG, PNG, WebP".

A single uploaded image thumbnail appears below the drop zone, showing a square color-gradient preview with a red circular X button in the top-right corner for removing the image. Next is the required label "편집 프롬프트 *" with a small "예시" button beside an icon. A large multiline text box is filled with the text "파일 처리 중에 작성한 다음 초안". Under the textbox is helper text: "어떤 표현이 거절되나요? 생성 가이드 보기" and a smaller line "이미지에 적용한 변경 사항을 설명해주세요." Beneath that is a rounded button labeled "고급 설정" with a gear icon.

Near the bottom is a credit section showing a coin/credit icon and "필요 크레딧: 3.9 크레딧" in bold, with "보유 크레딧: 100000 크레딧" below it. At the very bottom is a prominent blue primary button labeled "이미지 편집" with a magic-wand/sparkle style icon.

Layout/state: This is a mobile-sized single-column attachment/image-editing form. No sidebar or top navigation is visible. The screen appears loaded and usable, with an intentional upload-complete state and one attached image preview. Verdict: pass. No severe clipping, overflow, broken layout, blank regions, or error states observed.
